svg.title: Decision flow of Cedar's case close guard and the work-complete follow-up
svg.desc: Left lane, resolving a case: a CloseIncident request carries an IncidentResolution entity and a Status. The step runs on message Close, table incident, stage PreOperation. The plug-in takes the case ID from the incidentid lookup of the resolution, retrieves Case category and Root cause as the user, and rejects a Complaint without a root cause. It then counts active work orders of the case whose FieldLink status is not Completed, as SYSTEM, at most 51 rows with no columns, and rejects the request when the count is above zero. Otherwise the main operation resolves the case. Right lane, completing a work order: on Update PostOperation, when the pre-image and post-image show the status became Completed and the work order has a case, the plug-in counts the remaining open work orders of that case inside the transaction; when none remain and the case is still active it creates a task for the case owner.
svg.text: Resolving a case (C-10)
Completing a work order (C-09 v0.3)
CloseIncident request (form, Web API, flow)
IncidentResolution: Entity (incidentid = case)
Status: OptionSetValue (5 = Problem Solved)
Step: Close / incident / PreOperation (20), sync
No Target and no images on this message: read what you need.
Retrieve the case as the user
ColumnSet(cedar_casecategory, cedar_rootcause)
Complaint without a root cause? Reject (HTTP 400).
RetrieveMultiple work orders as SYSTEM
cedar_case = this case AND statecode = Active
AND FieldLink status is not Completed. No columns, top 51.
Count above 0? Reject with the count only (HTTP 400).
Stage 30: the platform resolves the case
Creates the case resolution activity, sets state Resolved.
A rejection throws InvalidPluginExecutionException:
nothing is written, the case stays Active.
Update of a work order that includes FieldLink status
Step G5: Update / cedar_workorder / PostOperation (40), sync
Images "pre" and "post" from lesson 66, with two more columns.
Status became Completed? Work order has a case?
From the images only. If not: stop, no data call at all.
Count the open work orders of the case as SYSTEM
Same query. It runs inside the transaction, so this work
order already counts as Completed. Any left? Stop.
Retrieve the case: statecode, ownerid
Case no longer Active? Stop.
Create a task for the case owner
subject: Work complete: review and resolve
regardingobjectid: the case; ownerid: its owner
Create is a new message: Depth 2, same transaction.
If the Create fails, the status update is rolled back too.
Omar sees the task on the case timeline and resolves the case.
One shared query, two identities: the user for what they do, SYSTEM for what must always hold.
